description: This Java class defines the 'ResourceCreated' event, which is emitted after a Resource is created within a policy context. It includes methods for constructing instances, JSON serialization/deserialization, and accessors for event properties.

classes.name: ResourceCreated
classes.description: Defines an event indicating that a Resource was created, with properties, constructors, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a ResourceCreated event instance with policy ID as String (deprecated) or PolicyId.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ResourceCreated instance from a JSON string or JSON object.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label associated with the event.

methods.name: getResource
methods.description: Returns the Resource object associated with the event.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Creates a new instance with an updated revision number.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new instance with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes event properties into a JSON object builder.
